title: The Information Bottleneck and the Holographic Kernel: A Structural Bridge Between Relevance-Preserving Compression and Regime-Aware Reconstructive Theory (EA-HK-IB-01 v1.1)
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A v1.1 revised theoretical bridge paper by Lee Sharks comparing the Information Bottleneck framework with the archive’s Holographic Kernel and Three Compressions frameworks.

The paper establishes a conceptual and structural correspondence between relevance-preserving compression and reconstruction-preserving kernels, then argues that Information Bottleneck coordinates underdetermine compression regime: two compressions can occupy the same information-plane coordinates while differing in fuel source, bearing cost, ledger structure, and commons effect. It proposes—not proves—that some Holographic Kernel operations may admit Information Bottleneck formalization once variables, targets, encoders, and decoders are specified. Whether archive kernels approach an estimated IB frontier remains an empirical research question.
